$comment: Places, exits and descriptions. text[0] is the first visit, text[1] a return visit (descriptions: varied). 'dark' needs a lit lamp to read; 'locks' names the item an exit needs; 'needs' names an item that must be carried to use an exit at all. The road is the way out and is not a place.

square.name: the square
text: Harrow Gate's square. A dry fountain, a notice board, cobbles worn smooth by carts.
The square again. Someone has chalked a crooked arrow on the fountain, pointing west.

market.name: the market
text: The market. Awnings sag over trestles of salt fish and rope.
The market again. The rope seller has moved his stall nearer the archive door.

archive.name: the archive
text: The town archive. Shelves of ledgers lean in toward a reading desk.
The archive again. Dust you disturbed earlier still hangs in the air.

chapel.name: the chapel
text: A small chapel. Candles gutter by a trapdoor in the floor, and a side door opens on the graveyard.
The chapel again. One of the candles has burned out since you were here.

cellar.name: the cellar
text: A low cellar of barrels and old nets. Something scratches behind the barrels.
The cellar again. Water drips somewhere behind the barrels.

graveyard.name: the graveyard
text: A walled graveyard. Lichen softens the names on the older stones.
The graveyard again. A crow has taken the highest stone.

gatehouse.name: the gatehouse
text: The gatehouse. A heavy arch opens on the west road.
The gatehouse again. The arch looks narrower than you remembered.

inn.name: the inn
text: The Lantern Inn. A low fire, a long table, and a guest ledger open on the counter.
The inn again. Someone has signed the ledger since you came in.

old quarter.name: the old quarter
text: The old quarter. Narrow houses lean together over a lane of broken paving.
The old quarter again. A shutter that was open is closed now.

well.name: the well
text: An old well with a broken winch. The shaft drops into the dark.
The well again. A cold breath rises from the shaft.

well bottom.name: the bottom of the well
text: The bottom of the well. Ankle-deep water, and a ledge of dry stone.
The well bottom again. Your rope still hangs where you left it.

tower.name: the old tower
text: The foot of the old tower. A door of black iron bars the stair, with words worked into it.
The foot of the tower again. The iron door is as cold as before.

tower top.name: the top of the tower
text: The top of the tower. The whole town lies below you, and the west road beyond the wall.
The tower top again. The wind has not let up.

barracks.name: the barracks yard
text: The barracks yard. A sparring ring of packed earth, and a stair up to the wall.
The barracks yard again. The ring has been raked since you were here.

wall walk.name: the wall walk
text: The wall walk. A narrow path along the battlements, the drop outside sheer and long.
The wall walk again. The wind tugs at you up here.
